text:
Sam P (partnerships): Quick sync — for the AWS/GCP/Azure listing onboarding we need staging tenant(s) + test SKU entitlements by EOD. Can ops provision a sandbox tenant and share one-time creds? cc @Jessica O (ops)
Jessica O (ops): On it. Need seller/publisher contact email + SKU slug and whether trial is enabled.
Raj K (product): SKU slug: redwood-inference-provisioning. Trial: 14d, metered billing. We haven't registered the seller ID for AWS yet — that requires publisher email verification.
Maria L (legal): From legal: no blockers for staging, but we need a signed checklist/POA before production go-live. Also: explicitly forbid using real customer data in test payloads (masking requirement).
Jessica O (ops): Starting sandbox provisioning now. I'll create IAM role, KMS key, and a scoped API key. ETA ~3 hours. Will stash creds in Vault and paste the path here (not raw creds).
deploy-bot: sandbox account created: acct-aws-stg-112233 — Vault path: secret/marketplace/staging/acct-aws-stg-112233
Sam P (partnerships): Awesome, thanks. Once creds are in Vault Partnerships will run packaging asset upload and screenshots for the marketplace preview.
Raj K (product): Also we need a small entitlement callback endpoint for marketplace reporting. I'll spin a test endpoint. Example curl for testing (use fake emails):
```
curl -X POST https://staging-redwood-inference/api/mkt/entitlement \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"sku":"redwood-inference-provisioning","user":"test@example.com","entitled":true}'
```
Maria L (legal): Reminder: use example.com for test accounts, and include this EULA line in test artifact docs: "No PII or customer data in test payloads."
Jessica O (ops): Creds created & rotated, limited-scope API key added to Vault. I uploaded SKU mapping CSV and IAM role ARNs. Link (partnerships+ops access): https://vault.redwood.internal/marketplace/staging
Sam P (partnerships): I'll start packaging tonight and do branding/screenshots. Can we slot a 15m sync tomorrow 09:15 PT to verify marketplace preview and entitlement flow? @Raj @Maria @Jessica
Raj K (product): Works for me.
Maria L (legal): Works for me.
Jessica O (ops): :thumbsup: I'll post the Vault access checklist and the role ARN before EOD.
Sam P (partnerships): Great — thanks team. I'll update the onboarding tracker after the preview step.
